feasibility_audit.summary: Observation panel contains 3 records (1 train), failing the required sufficiency threshold of >= 100 records. Cross-validated meta-learner stacking or multi-model blending on an underpowered panel is statistically unidentifiable and prone to extreme variance inflation. Under CHARTER-ENSEMBLING-STACKING deferral criteria, ensembling is formally deferred.

executive_summary: Gate 1 Feasibility DEFERRAL: The non-synthetic observation panel contains 3 records (1 in train), failing the pre-registered sufficiency threshold of >= 100. Cross-validated meta-learner stacking and multi-model ensembling on an underpowered panel is mathematically unidentifiable and prone to extreme variance inflation. Under Charter CHARTER-ENSEMBLING-STACKING deferral criteria, ensembling is formally DEFERRED. The production champion (Rung F L2 Conformal CatBoost) remains strictly unchanged.
governance_decision: DEFER: Insufficient non-synthetic observations to train or evaluate an ensemble model. Champion Rung F L2 Conformal CatBoost is retained without ensembling overhead.
